## Data Preparation

준비한 자료는  [E. Saez 교수의 홈페이지](http://elsa.berkeley.edu/~saez/)에 있는 [`TabFig2024.xls`](http://eml.berkeley.edu//~saez/TabFig2024.xls)` 를 손봐서 불러들인 것이다. 

```{r, readxl, message = FALSE, echo = FALSE, results = 'hide', eval = TRUE}
library(readxl)
library(magrittr)
v_names <- c("Year", "P90_100", "P95_100", "P99_100", "P99.5_100", "P99.9_100", "P99.99_100", "P90_95", "P95_99", "P99_99.5", "P99.5_99.9", "P99.9_99.99")
US_top_income_shares_24 <-
  readxl::read_excel("../data/TabFig2024.xlsx",
#                     sheet = "Table A3",
#                     range = "A6:M115",
                     range = "Table A3!A6:M117",
                     col_names = FALSE)
US_top_income_shares_24 %<>%
  `[`(-8)
names(US_top_income_shares_24) <- v_names
str(US_top_income_shares_24)
US_top_income_shares_24 %<>% 
  data.frame
class(US_top_income_shares_24$Year) <- "integer"
```

## Data

```{r, data structure, echo = FALSE}
library(knitr)
kable(format(US_top_income_shares_24, digits = 1, nsmall = 1))
```

## Save Data

```{r, save.image}
saveRDS(US_top_income_shares_24, file = "./US_top_income.RDS")
save.image(file = "US_top_income_shares_2024.RData")
```
